ranking.rationale: Owns the difficult requirement: a meaningful place-specific orthodox chess set whose original rules remain intact.
Strong coherent world and recognizable setting craft, but this request centers on a playable classic.
Strong architectural fidelity and printable detailing; declared transport focus is less direct than Alice.
Coherent modular board patterns, but does not own the chess classic or architectural collection.
Excellent role readability and combinatorial games; original abstract rules would violate the standard chess brief.
Strong personal group games; inventing a new game would depart from the required classic.
Precise physical models, but no science phenomenon is requested.
Mechanism craft adds motion that this standard chess set does not need.
Compact puzzles emphasize a different interaction from full chess.
Kinetic machinery would distract from the classic and architecture.
Small repeatable mechanisms do not own this full collectible set.
Optical transformation is absent from the requested experience.
Projected hidden stories are outside the held architectural chess promise.
Deployment would add complexity without improving the essential chess identity.
Captive topology does not contribute to the requested standard game.
Passive acoustic geometry is unrelated to the required interaction.
